_about: The sweater designs, written by art/world_assets/sweater/build.py from patterns.py: don't edit by hand. stars: 1 Common, 2 Rare, 3 Ultra rare, 4 Legendary. Each design's colour map is assets/sweaters/textures/<id>.png; scripts/sweaters.gd puts it on a character. Names and stars are drafts until Alex approves them.

designs.name: Cranberry Classic
designs.about: The reference sweater: plain red stockinette, red ribs.

designs.name: Oatmeal Stripe
designs.about: Oatmeal with pairs of chocolate stripes, the same down the sleeves; plain ribs.

designs.name: Forest Green
designs.about: Plain stockinette in one colour, ribs to match.

designs.about: Plain stockinette in one colour, ribs to match.

designs.about: Plain stockinette in one colour, ribs to match.

designs.name: Lavender
designs.about: Plain stockinette in one colour, ribs to match.

designs.name: Pumpkin
designs.about: Plain stockinette in one colour, ribs to match.

designs.name: Heather Tweed
designs.about: A tweedy yarn: the main colour flecked with other colours at random.

designs.name: Bark Tweed
designs.about: A tweedy yarn: the main colour flecked with other colours at random.

designs.name: Cream and Forest
designs.about: Plain body, ribs in a second colour.

designs.name: Charcoal Tipped
designs.about: Plain body, ribs in a second colour and a line of it just above the hem and each cuff.

designs.name: Breton
designs.about: Breton stripes: a two-row stripe every five rows from the chest down, plain above; striped sleeves; plain ribs.

designs.name: Rust Stripe
designs.about: Even six-row stripes of two colours, all over.

designs.name: Mint Candy
designs.about: Two rows of the second colour and one of the third every nine rows.

designs.name: Rose Block
designs.about: The top in one colour, the bottom in another, a line of a third between; the sleeves split at the elbow the same way.

designs.name: Sage and Cream
designs.about: The body in one colour, the sleeves and collar in another.

designs.name: Denim Pinstripe
designs.about: A thin vertical stripe every six stitches.

designs.name: Buttercup Dots
designs.about: Single-stitch dots on a staggered six by six grid.

designs.name: Plum Stripe
designs.about: Plain, with three stripes across the chest and the upper sleeves (cream, gold, cream).

designs.name: Dusk Ombre
designs.about: Five shades in bands from dark at the hem to light at the shoulders, the edges dithered.

designs.name: Snowfall Yoke
designs.about: Navy with a cream Fair Isle yoke: a band of snowflakes between peerie borders round the shoulders, red seeds between the flakes, and a peerie band above each cuff. Cream collar edge.

designs.name: Argyle
designs.about: Argyle: diamonds of a second colour on the main one, crossed by thin lines of a third.

designs.name: Picnic Gingham
designs.about: Gingham: four-stitch checks, where the two colours cross they make the deep one.

designs.name: Houndstooth
designs.about: Houndstooth on an eight-stitch repeat.

designs.name: Chevron
designs.about: Zigzag stripes of three colours, the points down the front.

designs.name: Navy Polka
designs.about: Round dots, four stitches across, on a staggered grid.

designs.name: Cornflower Lattice
designs.about: A diamond lattice of thin lines, a dot in every other diamond.

designs.name: April Showers
designs.about: Clouds on the shoulders and rain falling below them, a drop at a time.

designs.name: Strawberry Patch
designs.about: Strawberries scattered all over, seeds and leaves and all.

designs.name: Sweetheart
designs.about: A row of hearts across the chest between pink peerie borders, and hearts above the cuffs.

designs.name: Peerie Bands
designs.about: Little peerie borders all the way down in brown, red and green, with thin lines between.

designs.name: Winter Pines
designs.about: A forest of cream pines round the bottom of the body and above the cuffs, snow falling above.

designs.name: Tulip Border
designs.about: A border of tulips in three colours round the hem and above each cuff.

designs.name: Greyspine Peaks
designs.about: The Greyspine range round the body: grey peaks with snow caps against the sky, a line of dark pines along their feet.

designs.name: Daisy Chain
designs.about: Daisies round the yoke and the hem and above the cuffs, joined by a green line.

designs.name: Flock of Friends
designs.about: Sage green with a flock of cream sheep (dark faces and legs) across the chest and a smaller line of them round the back, a scatter of cream daisies below, a sheep on each upper sleeve. Ribs in deep green.

designs.name: Sunflower Field
designs.about: A field of tall sunflowers round the bottom of the body against a summer sky, one on each sleeve.

designs.name: Falling Leaves
designs.about: Maple leaves falling all over in orange, red and gold.

designs.name: Fox in the Pines
designs.about: Foxes peeping out across the chest, between bands of pines; pines above the cuffs.

designs.name: Reindeer
designs.about: Nordic reindeer facing each other across the chest between snowflake and peerie bands, red and cream.

designs.name: Honeycomb
designs.about: Honeycomb all over in two golds, busy bees here and there.

designs.name: Toadstools
designs.about: Toadstools, red and brown, round the bottom of a mossy body and here and there above.

designs.name: Saltmeadow Light
designs.about: Saltmeadow's lighthouse on the front, gulls overhead, waves all the way round below.

designs.name: Home Sweet Home
designs.about: Gran's cottage on the front: red roof, lit windows, smoke from the chimney, on green hills that roll round to pines at the back.

designs.name: After the Rain
designs.about: A rainbow across the front with clouds at its ends, little clouds round the back, rainbow stripes above the cuffs.

designs.name: Midnight Moon
designs.about: Indigo, scattered with gold stars, and across the chest the moon going round: eight phases from new to full and back, in cream with gold rings, between two gold lines. Gold-tipped ribs.

designs.name: Golden Fleece
designs.about: Deep teal and gold: a flock of golden sheep across the chest between gold peerie borders, gold and cream stars all over, a golden sheep on each sleeve, gold-tipped ribs.

designs.name: Northern Lights
designs.about: The northern lights over a night sky: green curtains with violet tops fading to teal, stars above, a black forest round the bottom.

designs.name: Gran's Heirloom
designs.about: Gran's heirloom: Fair Isle bands from collar to hem in six colours, peerie, XO, snowflake and star borders on changing grounds, the same down the sleeves.

designs.name: Four Seasons
designs.about: The year round the body: spring tulips on the front, summer sunflowers on her left, autumn leaves on the back, winter snowflakes on her right, cream seams between; the sleeves go through the seasons from shoulder to cuff.
